5.3.2.2.3 Storing Immediately
On the update of a RAM block for which dirtyFlagSupport is set to true and NvBlock-
Needs.storeImmediate is set to true, the RTE invokes the NvM_WriteBlock function of
the NvM module with the BlockId mapped using RteNvRamAllocation. There are two
options through which this can be achieved:
• Using Task Activation, a DataReceivedEvent is configured for the NvBlockNeeds
of this NvBlockDescriptor. If this DataReceivedEvent is mapped to a task, then
RTE activates the task from the context of the task mapped to the runnable with
the write access. This is done after the runnable with the write access terminates.
The runnable mapped to the DataReceivedEvent is implemented by RTE to call
the NvM_WriteBlock API.
• From Request context, a DataReceivedEvent is configured for the NvBlockNeeds
of this NvBlockDescriptor. If this DataReceivedEvent is not mapped to any task,
then RTE calls the NvM_WriteBlock API from inside the context of the task
mapped to the runnable with the write access. This is done after the runnable
with the write access terminates.
